name: RENOVA, Inc.
summary: RENOVA, Inc. engages in the development and operation of renewable energy power plant in Japan. It operates through Renewable Energy Power Generation Business and Development and Operation Business segments. The Renewable Energy Power Generation Business segment generates and sells electricity from renewable energy power plants. The Development and Operation Business develops and assists in the operation of renewable energy power plants. It generates electricity through solar, biomass, onshore wind, geothermal, and hydro power plants, as well as engages in energy storage business. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
